title: Chapter 437
text:
Only by randomly getting [Item] would he have a chance to draw a Mission Completion Card.

Old Plum, you must be a fake main character!

I'm done for!

He turned to look at Aroshia and felt that touching her would be more reliable …

Aroshia looked over and stared at him for three seconds, expressionless.

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly, rubbed his temples, and comforted himself. It's only my first time. It's normal to have some setbacks …

Han Xiao knew that his chances of getting a Mission Completion Card on his first try were slim. Although talents were not what he needed the most now, it was not bad either.

Sigh, it would be much more convenient if the players were here. I could just give them a mission and ask them to hand in the Mission Completion Card. Then, I wouldn't have to rely on luck.

Han Xiao shook his head and looked at the interface.

Please choose one of the three talents below.

Fire Affinity: + 16% Fire Resistance, + 10% Fire Ability Effects

Advanced Mental Resilience: + 35% Mental Resistance, Charm, Confusion, Sensory Deprivation, Intimidation, Fear, and other mind control skills have a lower Mental Resistance Test difficulty, -30% Duration

Cell Engine: + 21% Energy Recovery Rate, + 330 Energy

Han Xiao already had a choice. [Fire Affinity] was suitable for the Mage class, but it had a limited effect on him. [Cell Engine] was not bad, but it was not as practical as [Advanced Mental Resilience]. The talents with the prefix 'Advanced' were usually not bad. Coincidentally, the Psychic class had some weaknesses against the armor of the Mechanic class, so this talent could greatly increase his mental resistance.

Furthermore, it could be used immediately.

Thinking about it, Han Xiao suddenly realized that something was wrong.

Why did I become tanky again?

Is there really no way to change the attributes of a meat shield! I want the Void Zone, Graveegg!!

After counting, he had received all the rewards. Although he did not get a Mission Completion Card, he had gained quite a lot from this trip. He had gotten two talents, a Character Summon Card that felt useless, and more than 2,000,000 experience and 200,000 Enas. It was a worthwhile trip.

Chen Xing was looking at him with a smile, politely sending him off. He suppressed his impatience and wanted to do his own things after the mercenaries left.

Han Xiao took the initiative to extend his hand. "Since the mission is completed, we won't stay any longer."

"Alright, if there's a chance in the future, I'll look for you to work together again."

Chen Xing smiled and held Han Xiao's hand.

Suddenly, without any warning, his palm locked onto Chen Xing like an iron gate. Han Xiao exerted his strength and dragged Chen Xing, who was caught off guard, over.

In the blink of an eye, the Void Dragon Mech was attached to his body. First, it covered the helmet. Han Xiao leaned back slightly and then fiercely headbutted Chen Xing. His armored forehead slammed into the corner of Chen Xing's eyes.

Bang!

Being suddenly attacked, Chen Xing saw stars from the collision.

The Mech was fully attached to his body. Han Xiao activated the various bonus modules of the Void Dragon. The electromagnetic pulse controller stimulated his body and entered the [Excited] state. Together with the attribute bonus from the battle mode, his strength increased by more than a hundred points. One hit was not enough. He followed it up with a fierce headbutt. The second hit caused Chen Xing to enter a temporary stun state.

Taking advantage of this short opportunity, Han Xiao grabbed Chen Xing's head with both hands and released [Void Jet]. A gray shockwave burst forth from his palms!

Boom!

The shockwave spread and turned the luxurious hotel suite into a mess in an instant. It was as if a strong wind had swept through.

"What are you doing?"

Herlous, Sylvia, and the three Volga brothers were all shocked!

Oh my god, a mercenary is attacking his employer!

He was so harmonious just a second ago. Why did he suddenly attack?

"You …" Chen Xing's resistance was not low. After taking two Void Jet attacks, he finally regained his senses. His eyes turned pure white, and a surge of psychic power pushed everyone away.

He held his head that was in unbearable pain and glared at Han Xiao. He bit his lips with a shocked and angry expression.

He did not understand why Han Xiao suddenly attacked him, but it did not stop him from feeling threatened.

"Ah!"

Chen Xing opened his mouth and channeled his psychic power into his voice. The sharp high-pitched voice was like a spear that stabbed into everyone's brains, causing them to feel intense pain.

Everyone's vision turned black. Their organs tightened and throbbed. They felt nauseous and nauseous. Their heads were dizzy. Sylvia was the most vulnerable. She held her head and felt a splitting headache. It was as if her brain was going to explode into blood the next moment.

Han Xiao also felt intense pain. It was as if a file was scraping his brain. The [Advanced Mental Resilience] that he had just obtained was immediately put to use. When he chose this talent, he had already planned to use it. It greatly reduced mental damage and negative effects, so it was just right to deal with Psychics.

After all, he knew Chen Xing very well.

Enduring the pain, he pounced forward, and with a swift and heavy flying elbow, he cut through Chen Xing's hastily condensed psychic shield like a battle axe. With an ear-piercing sound of air exploding, his elbow landed heavily on Chen Xing's delicate face.

Pa!

Blood spurted out from his nose and mouth. Chen Xing covered his bloody mouth and retreated in panic. His eyes were filled with shock and anger.

"Herlous, go and block the guards outside. The three brothers, protect Sylvia. Don't come near."

Han Xiao spoke very quickly, and his hands were not idle either. His fists, which were wrapped in armor, broke Chen Xing's shield time and time again, forcing him to retreat step by step. He did not have time to release any more psychic attacks, and he slowly approached the corner.

"What the hell is going on?!" Herlous was still in a daze. He clenched his teeth and decided to believe Han Xiao. There had to be a reason for him to do this.

Bang bang bang …

Herlous rushed out of the room. He swung his Battleship Slicing Blade and blocked the guards who had rushed over. The sounds of fighting were chaotic.

"You … Get out! Open! "

Chen Xing screamed like a woman. Blood flowed out of his eyes. He used some kind of secret technique to stimulate his mind. His psychic power exploded, and the windows and walls in the room exploded. Debris flew everywhere, and dust filled the air. Han Xiao was also pushed to the side.

Chen Xing clenched his teeth and activated his psychic power. All the junk in the room floated into the air and gathered into a torrent, smashing toward Han Xiao continuously. It hit his chest, making it difficult for him to get close.

At this time, Chen Xing's face was covered in blood. His beautiful clothes were covered in dust and blood. He was also in a very bad state. He had a concussion from being hammered by Han Xiao. He could not focus, and his psychic power was sluggish.

The next second, Chen Xing grabbed the four statues on the ground with his psychic power. Like a thirsty person, he could not wait to put the statues on his forehead.

A strange psychic rhythm floated in the air. In his vision, invisible to the naked eye, the psychic current in the statues was continuously absorbed by Chen Xing. His psychic power was revitalized and quickly strengthened.

This was the effect of the statues on Chen Xing. The psychic current in them was a super tonic for him and could strengthen his psychic power. He could even use ritual items that were prayed to for a long time to strengthen his psychic power. This was a school of Psychics, absorbing psychic currents to strengthen oneself. It was relatively rare, but the side effects were very strong. Usually, one would be attacked by the psychic current and damage one's mind.

Seeing this, Aroshia wanted to go forward and stop him. However, she found that Han Xiao, who was blocking the debris in the air, secretly made a hand gesture to her, indicating that she should not move. Aroshia stopped and watched quietly.

Originally, one had to be careful when absorbing the psychic current in the statues. When it involved the mind, one had to be careful. Otherwise, one's mind would be attacked by the countless thoughts. However, Chen Xing could not care so much now. God knew if this mercenary had gone crazy. He only knew that if he did not save himself, his life would be in danger.

Huff huff huff …

After absorbing the psychic current in the four statues, the statues fell to the ground one after another, losing all their uniqueness, leaving only their hard shells.

After absorbing the huge psychic current, Chen Xing's eyes turned red. The terrifying psychic power rippled around him, distorting the air. His psychic power was so thick that it was almost visible to the naked eye. His head no longer hurt, and his waist no longer ached. He had recovered to his peak state and even exceeded his limit.

"You actually beat me up like this. I … I will turn you into my silent slave!!"

Chen Xing wiped the blood from his mouth and nose. His tone was shrill, and he gritted his teeth. He was like a woman who had discovered that she was disfigured.

The thick psychic power gathered, and he was about to unleash a full force attack.

At this moment, Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He suddenly activated Hella's Character Summon Card, and the phantom of a red-haired woman appeared behind him.

[Whisper of the Dead]: Causes three psychic attacks to the target. Damage depends on the user's INT or MYS attribute (can be specified). Reduces the target's status by 15%. Lasts for three hours. Number of uses 2/8.

Han Xiao's eyes shot out dark red energy, penetrating through the armor's eyes and shooting straight at Chen Xing.

Although he did not have any psychic attack skills, his INT was very high. Three consecutive attacks were not bad.

Hum!

Chen Xing's vision spun. His mind was heavily damaged, and he instantly lost control of his psychic power. This ball of psychic power exploded on its own before it could be released, and all the debris fell to the ground.

Blood spurted out from his mouth and nose, and Chen Xing's eyes turned blood red. This was not a skill that pushed him to the limit, but the capillaries in his eyes had exploded.

A Psychic's mental resistance should be very high, but Chen Xing's mind seemed to be defenseless and was directly damaged.

The state that he had just recovered suddenly fell to the bottom, or even worse. His thoughts were extremely slow, and his knees were weak. Chen Xing knelt down, panting heavily. He grabbed a statue and could not believe it.

"You … You did something?!"
